attempted_claim: Let k be an algebraically closed field of characteristic 5, G a finite abelian group of order prime to 5, and V a two-dimensional principally realized Yetter-Drinfeld module over kG with braiding matrix q11=q, q22=-1 and q12*q21=q^(-1) where q is a primitive Nth root of unity with N greater than 2 and 5 not dividing N, i.e. connected rank-two diagonal braiding of super type with one fermionic vertex whose Nichols algebra B(V) is finite-dimensional as in characteristic zero. Classify up to Hopf algebra isomorphism all finite-dimensional pointed Hopf algebras H over k with coradical kG and infinitesimal braiding V, over every such G and principal realization in this scope. Present each H by explicit generators extending B(V)#kG with deformed super quantum Serre relations and deformed fermionic power relation for the -1 vertex adapted to characteristic 5 including which structure constants vanish mod 5, state exact vanishing and centrality constraints on the lifting scalars in terms of the realization datum and N, exhibit for each H an explicit multiplicative Hopf 2-cocycle or Hochschild 2-cocycle ledger entry on B(V)#kG witnessing H as a cocycle deformation, and give necessary and sufficient parameter conditions for two such H to be isomorphic. A complete answer is the explicit finite family list with relations, parameter constraints, cocycle witnesses, and isomorphism dichotomy covering every object in scope.
claim_type: complete modular lifting classification with mod-5 super-Serre/fermionic-power deformations and isomorphism dichotomy
decisive_failure: originality: Nearest prior work substantively implies the headline: Angiono-Garcia Iglesias diagonal-type lifting theorem classifies all finite-dimensional diagonal-type liftings over cosemisimple H as cocycle deformations u(lambda), and Heckenberger/Angiono give the exact super-type Nichols presentation (s, x2^2, x12^2, x1^N, dim 4N) with identical chi-triviality and cocycle/isomorphism formulas. Under the admitted scope 5 not dividing N|G|, every characteristic-sensitive step (q-numbers, Gaussian binomials, Maschke) carries over verbatim, as the DRAFT itself states (identical/carryover). No new relation, deformation, or mod-5 vanishing appears; the w-correction is the known super-type root-vector interaction. Positive-characteristic novelty in the literature concerns the excluded p-dividing locus. Hence a mere base-field parameter substitution, mechanically implied, not new. value: TARGET audit with no fallback presumption. The scope excludes exactly where characteristic 5 could matter (N=5 or 5 dividing |G|), leaving the locus where nothing extra vanishes mod 5 by the authors' own theorem statement. The result is therefore a char-0 super-type lifting restatement with p=5 substituted: no new boundary, extremal witness, benchmark, census, or downstream use. The recognized positive-characteristic question (restricted structures, p-dividing Nichols phenomena per Xiong and Lei et al.) is excluded, not advanced. Falls under STANDARD reject list: mere parameter substitution and arbitrary slice that avoids the motivated difficulty, even though correct.
